I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092.

That number comes from Ilse in #north-random on Oct 13. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. Ilse said the ticket is open, and she warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on too.

Dana also told me privately, in our direct messages, her own guess about a future ticket number for the hub replacement. I kept that out of the channel.
